chunks: A speaker from among them said: 'Do not kill Joseph, but throw him into the depth of the well; some caravan may pick him up, if you must do so.'

key_terms.غَيَابَةِ الْجُبِ: the depth/remote part of the well

ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brother suggest instead of killing him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the strategic wisdom of the eldest brother, often identified as Reuben, who sought to preserve Joseph's life while ensuring his eventual return to Jacob. By casting him into a 'remote well' (ghayabat al-jub), the brothers inadvertently set in motion the divine plan for Joseph's elevation, turning a moment of fraternal jealousy into a trial of patience and providence.
